# data.docker_compose_images

<!-- Code generated by tools/genskill from the provider schema. DO NOT EDIT. -->

Kind: data-source. Back to [SKILL.md](../SKILL.md).

Lists the images the containers of a compose project use, like `docker compose images`: one entry per container (stopped ones included) with the image inspect fields.
